name: 6805-eagledecode-8b-1gpu
model: Target NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct at float16, ~16 GB -- the ungated mirror of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct, same weights; the Meta Llama 3 Community License applies. Draft head lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B, one layer, float16, 2048 max positions.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 320 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, seed 42, over /v1/chat/completions. Prompts exactly 1000 tokens and generations exactly 1000 tokens, both with zero spread; guidellm sets `ignore_eos`, so every generation runs to its full length. Longest sequence the server sees is ~2012 tokens, just inside the draft head's 2048 positions. Radix cache left on at its default -- prompts are independently sampled, so there is nothing to reuse.
purpose: A streaming chat assistant with speculative drafting, serving 32 concurrent users thousand-token prompts and replies on one GPU.
launch:
# Ungated mirror of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct, same weights; the Meta Llama 3
# Community License applies.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
trust-remote-code: true

# float16, not the mirror checkpoint's bfloat16: the EAGLE head below is a float16 checkpoint.
dtype: float16

# Pinned, not left to auto-selection: unset, this model on this GPU resolves to a different
# attention implementation.
attention-backend: flashinfer

speculative-algorithm: EAGLE
speculative-draft-model-path: lmsys/sglang-EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B
speculative-num-steps: 2
speculative-eagle-topk: 1
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 3

mem-fraction-static: 0.80
